title: Pyramids in the Elysium region
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Pyramids in the Elysium region, about unspecified at Elysium, Mars, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: probes photographed huge pyramids some 500 M High some with four sides just like the Great Pyramids of Giza

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that space probes photographed huge pyramids in a region of Mars called Elysium. According to him, some stand about 500 meters high and some have four sides, just like the Great Pyramids of Giza in Egypt. If true, it would suggest someone once built things on Mars.
